# Lavendar Lewis

[Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge)

## Appearance

Lavendar Lewis is a sweet and pretty lady with thick, beautifully wavy snow-white hair that is carefully arranged in becoming puffs and coils. She has a fresh, almost girlish face paired with big, sweet eyes of a wood-brown shade containing little golden glints.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v3 ch.Again P58](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0058), [v3 ch.People P3](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0003)_

## Personality

Lavendar Lewis relies heavily on her imagination to cope with life's difficulties. Since an earlier period, she maintains a deeply creative mindset, using pretend scenarios as an essential means to sustain herself.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)_

## History

Before her marriage, Lavendar Lewis lived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with her young servant, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), named by her father after lavender because he was so fond of the scent. After accidentally wandering onto her property, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduced Lavendar to [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), leading Lavendar to share her quiet sadness and reveal her past broken engagement with Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) subsequently helped arrange a reunion between Lavendar and [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md), leading to their reconciliation, engagement, and a garden wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Following her marriage, [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) was closed, though Lavendar eventually hosted visits from [Anne](../character/anne.md) and questioned her regarding her complicated relationship with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +390 more_

## Quotes

> "But oh, won’t you stay and have tea with me? Please, do. Mr. Kimball’s will have tea over before you get there. And Charlotta the Fourth and I will be so glad to have you."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

> "It gave me a shock to hear about Stephen’s son that first day you were here, Anne. I’ve never been able to mention him to you since, but I’ve wanted to know all about him. What sort of a boy is he?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "Oh, I’m not so old as I thought . . . and I don’t need a single blue pill! Girls, when you come back with your strawberries we’ll have tea out here under the silver poplar. I’ll have it all ready for you with home-grown cream."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P36](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0036)

> "About your age I think. He ought to be older because I dreamed him long before you were born. But I’ll never let him get any older than eleven or twelve; because if I did some day he might grow up altogether and then I’d lose him."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P61](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0061)

> "I’m wholesomely ashamed to think that a new dress . . . even it is a forget-me-not organdy . . . should exhilarate me so, when a good conscience and an extra contribution to Foreign Missions couldn’t do it."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P19](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0019)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss Lavendar meets [Anne](../character/anne.md) when [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally gets lost in the woods and ends up at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). The two quickly become very dear intimate friends and kindred spirits, sharing stories, tea, and personal confidences. [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps cheer Lavendar during quiet moments, facilitates her reunion with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and stays close with her as a trusted confidante.

- Friend of — very dear intimate friends and kindred spirits  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), +2 more</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) serves as Miss Lavendar's young maid at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Beyond performing household duties and serving tea, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) deeply cares for Lavendar's wellbeing, often confiding her worries about her mistress's melancholy behavior to [Anne](../character/anne.md).

- Commands — employer  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), +4 more</sub>

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Diana](../character/diana.md) first meets Miss Lavendar when she and [Anne](../character/anne.md) lose their way in the woods and are invited into [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for tea. [Diana](../character/diana.md) becomes a frequent visitor who brings joy to Lavendar's life, later returning to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to assist in the preparations for Lavendar's wedding.

### [Irving](../character/irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss Lavendar and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) were former lovers who experienced a broken engagement years prior. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps facilitate their reconciliation, they court once again and eventually marry in a garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), later hosting visits from friends like [Anne](../character/anne.md).

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--paul-irving.md)

Introduced through [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) forms an immediate bond with Miss Lavendar as a kindred spirit. They spend time together in the garden sharing stories, imagination, and thoughts about dream-boys and creative visions.

- Friend of — kindred spirits sharing stories and imagination in the garden  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051)</sub>

### [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

Miss Lavendar was previously engaged to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) twenty-five years earlier before a falling-out ended their romance. After [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) returns expressing a desire to reconnect, the two reconcile at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and are happily married in a garden ceremony surrounded by friends.

- Romantically involved with — formerly engaged twenty-five years ago  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
